items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Babs [phonetic sp.] was with me singing... I got a phone -- what I did was I did standards. 'Cause Eddie Jefferson came with me, you know. Babs [phonetic sp.] was with me singing

ctx.x: Oh, he didn't know your playing at all?
He didn't know my playing at all. No. The way I got with Dizzy's band was Babs Gonzales [phonetic sp.] told Dizzy about me from being in Newark.
Oh. You and Babs knew each other from?
